Subject: RE: Fwd: Urgent: Elevated 5xx/429s in production (NovaApps)

Quick update from infra: autoscaler shows a backlog of pending node allocs for NovaApps' Dedicated pool (pending state on 3 GPU hosts). Provisioning requests were submitted at 12:05 but cloud provider quotas and instance boot time are creating a ~14–22 minute lag. We're also seeing extreme KV-cache churn leading to OOM on the more memory-heavy model variant; that is causing 5xx bursts when requests hit cold KV windows.

Mitigation plan (immediate):
- Enable emergency fallback: switch NovaApps traffic to their hosted model variant (smaller TLM quant) which reduces per-request GPU memory by ~40%. This is a config toggle on our side; estimate 3–6 minutes to take effect.
- If fallback not accepted, spin up Dedicated burst pool in a different zone (cross-zone burst) — estimate 18–25 minutes including boot and registration.
- Apply temporary rate-limiter at the edge for NovaApps at 25% above baseline to reduce retry amplification while autoscaler converges.

Attachments: short API trace showing OOM signatures (api_trace_1207.txt).

I'll apply the fallback now unless anyone objects.

- Hannah
SRE, Redwood Inference
